set.stimulus:

Persons in Row 1 face south and persons in Row 2 face north, so each person in Row 1 faces a person in Row 2. The persons are T, U, V, W, X, L, M, N, P and Q, not necessarily in the same order. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

4. U does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the row.
5. X sits at one of the extreme ends of the row.
6. W sits to the immediate right of the one who faces L.
7. N sits to the immediate right of X.
8. Neither L nor M is an immediate neighbour of N.
9. L sits in Row 2.

Clue 5 then places X.
Clue 7 cannot be met in Case 1a, so it is rejected.
Clues 7 and 8 then place N and M.
T takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — W, U, T, N, X; Row 2 — P, L, Q, M, V.
On either side of N sit X and T — **T and X**.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Parallel rows
set.stimulus:
Ten persons sit in two parallel rows of five persons each, one row behind the other. All of them face north and Row 1 is in front of Row 2, so each person in Row 2 sits directly behind a person in Row 1. The persons are L, M, N, P, Q, T, U, V, W and X, not necessarily in the same order.

1. Only one person sits between N and U.
2. P is not an immediate neighbour of X.
3. P and X sit in the same row.
4. W is an immediate neighbour of M.
5. Neither P nor L sits at an extreme end of the row.
6. M sits second to the right of L.
7. N sits third to the right of V.
8. Only one person sits between T and U.
9. T sits directly in front of X.
